metadata.description: C4 Container diagram of a Google Apps Script web app restricted to a Google Workspace OU. The app (Code.gs + Index.html) executes as the deployer and reads/writes data.json stored on the deployer's Google Drive via the Drive API

elements.name: User
elements.description: Workspace OU member accessing the web app via browser

elements.name: Apps Script Web App
elements.description: Web app deployed via Google Apps Script. OU-restricted. Executes as the deployer identity

elements.name: Index.html
elements.description: Frontend served to the user. Calls Code.gs for data operations

elements.name: Code.gs
elements.description: Backend script handling Drive API calls to read and write data.json

elements.name: Google Drive
elements.description: Deployer's Google Drive hosting the data.json file

elements.name: data.json
elements.description: JSON file on the deployer's Google Drive. Read and written by Code.gs via the Drive API
